en: The Alliance of Nations stands as a beacon of global collaboration, tirelessly working to maintain peace, security, and cooperation among nations. Through diplomatic channels and joint initiatives, member countries pool their resources and expertise to address emerging challenges and forge a more harmonious international community.

Neutrality serves as a cornerstone of Sordland's foreign policy, fostering an approach of non-alignment with any power bloc or alliance. By maintaining a neutral stance, Sordland aims to preserve its autonomy, enhance diplomatic flexibility, and promote peaceful relations with nations across the globe.

The Organization for Merkopan Economic Cooperation, of which the Republic of Sordland is a member, plays a pivotal role in stimulating economic progress and fostering continental trade. By promoting collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and harmonization of trade policies among member nations, this organization facilitates increased economic integration, trade diversification, and mutually beneficial partnerships.

Sordland's economic landscape underwent a significant transformation when former President Ewald Alphonso implemented free market reforms, shifting the country from a planned doctrine to a more market-oriented approach. This transition has placed Sordland in a unique position, straddling the realms of two distinct economic systems. The ongoing challenge lies in striking a balance between these ideologies and harnessing the potential benefits while mitigating any adverse consequences.

The EPA implemented in 1932, safeguards Sordland's energy industry from excessive foreign ownership. The Act was amended in 1949 under the Alphonso government setting the limit of foreign ownership in national security-sensitive energy corporations at 20 percent.

As part of our economic policy, we are actively promoting a market economy system, encouraging businesses to transition towards this goal. By embracing market principles, such as supply and demand dynamics, fair competition, and private ownership, we aim to create a business environment that fosters innovation, growth, and sustainable economic development.

In line with our economic vision, we are advocating for a planned economy system, urging businesses to align their operations with this approach. Through comprehensive economic planning and coordinated resource allocation, we aim to optimize productivity, ensure social welfare, and achieve long-term economic stability and growth.
Constitution Amendments Require Assembly and Supreme Court

According to Article 5 of the Constitution, an amendment may be proposed by members of the Assembly with at least 150 signatures. A two-thirds majority vote in the Grand National Assembly and a simple majority vote in the Supreme Court is required for the amendment.

Former President, Tarquin Soll, declared the Bludish Freedom Party or BFP to be an illegal criminal organization due to their secessionist activities. Any suspected member of the party shall be arrested without trial. Any event, operation or organization suspected to be colluding with the BFP will be disbanded and its partakers arrested.

According to Article 18 and 51, the President may issue decrees on political, social, and economic issues that would carry the force of law. However, they could not contradict the constitution and are subject to judicial review. The Assembly may pass legislation on the same subjects to override presidential decrees.

Article 99 of the new Constitution defines the “Member of Honor” title, its appointment procedure as well as the rights their members may exercise. A Member of Honor has absolute immunity and is a permanent member of the Grand National Assembly. He/She is entitled to his/her security team, provided by the State’s Presidential Guards. A member is also eligible to live in a special private residence provided by the State for free. The only Member of Honor is Tarquin Soll.

According to Article 17 of the new Constitution, the President of Sordland is not responsible for the actions performed in the exercise of presidential duties, except in the case of high treason or violation of the Constitution. In such cases, the President may be impeached by the Supreme Court in a joint session, with an absolute majority of its members.

The Justices of the Supreme Court are not held individually responsible for the actions performed in the exercise of their duties. This principle safeguards their independence and shields them from personal liability while upholding the impartiality of their judicial decision-making.

The President appoints ministers to the Council of Ministers from among the elected members of the Assembly. This process fosters political inclusiveness and allows for representation from various parties in the executive decision-making process.

A reform committee has been convened to engage in extensive discussions on the potential revisions and updates to the constitution. This inclusive dialogue involves representatives from all political parties within the government, providing an opportunity for comprehensive constitutional review and reform.

Article 6 of the Sordish Constitution identifies all citizens as 'Sords,' irrespective of their ethnicities or cultures. Article 7 states that every Sord is equal before the law, implying equal rights and responsibilities for all citizens.

The region of Bergia is currently structured as a "Special Zone" and has a different governance structure than the rest of the country. Established by Tarquin Soll after the bloody revolts of the separationists, the Special Zone was aimed to eliminate the security threats in the region and to maintain peace. There are no municipal elections within the Special Zone and the region is governed by a governor with expanded powers from the city of Deyr -- who is usually appointed by the president. Special Zone has its own security forces and is not in the jurisdiction of the Interior Ministry.

According to the Constitution of Sordland, there are no limitations on the number of terms the President can serve. This provision allows for the possibility of the President being elected and reelected for consecutive terms without any restrictions or term limits. The absence of term limits provides stability in leadership and continuity in governance, allowing the President to potentially serve an unlimited number of terms if reelected by the electorate.

According to Article 50 of the new Constitution, a political party needs a minimum of 10% of the total national vote to win seats in the Grand National Assembly. The votes of the parties who pass the threshold are re-distributed proportionally.

Article 77 and 82 of the new Constitution grant the President the authority to veto a bill by returning it to the Assembly with a written statement. This veto power serves as a check and balance mechanism, allowing the President to express concerns and initiate further deliberations on proposed legislation.

In Sordland, the military operates as a conscripted force, where the duty of military service falls upon males upon reaching the age of 18. This mandatory conscription ensures a consistent and capable pool of personnel to uphold the nation's defense and security, strengthening the overall resilience and readiness of the military.

The Gendarmerie, an esteemed armed law enforcement organization, stands as a bulwark in preserving security and public order, with a primary focus on rural security. Furthermore, the Gendarmerie's versatility allows it to be flexibly deployed to assist cities under the guidance and request of mayors, fortifying law enforcement capabilities and fostering safer environments for all.

The Sordish General Staff, comprising esteemed and seasoned generals, serves as a pivotal military planning body. This esteemed assembly of top-ranking officers engages in meticulous strategizing and coordination to develop comprehensive plans and strategies that optimize the military's operational efficacy and ensure the successful execution of defense objectives.

Members of the security apparatus in Sordland enjoy privileges and benefits that extend beyond those available to the general population. These special provisions reflect the unique nature of their responsibilities and the crucial role they play in safeguarding the nation's security and stability.

Under the law, educational institutes are granted the freedom to teach Creationism or Evolution as part of their curriculum. This ensures that schools have the autonomy to choose the approach that aligns with their educational philosophy. It allows for a diverse range of perspectives and encourages critical thinking among students. The law acknowledges the importance of academic freedom and respects the rights of educational institutions to shape their curriculum according to their values and beliefs. By providing this flexibility, the law promotes a balanced and inclusive learning environment.

The longstanding welfare principles that have traditionally guided the provision of welfare services by the Renan Aristocracy are currently under scrutiny and evaluation. These principles, which have shaped welfare practices for a significant duration, are being critically assessed to determine their effectiveness and relevance in meeting the evolving needs of the population.

For an extended period, Sordland has upheld a voluntary vaccination policy, allowing individuals to exercise their freedom of choice regarding vaccination for themselves and their children. This policy has granted citizens the autonomy to decide whether to receive vaccinations, based on personal beliefs and preferences.
Sordland is experiencing a moderate level of foreign influence within its energy sector, creating certain challenges in maintaining control over domestic energy policies and decision-making.

Sordland is currently enjoying a period of balanced energy prices, reflecting stability in both supply and demand within the sector. This equilibrium has the potential to contribute positively to the economy, fostering a conducive environment for steady growth and sustainable economic planning.

Sordland is currently grappling with fluctuating energy prices, a development causing uncertainty in the domestic market. This unpredictability may lead to significant repercussions for Sordland's economy and can influence both domestic policy and international trade relations.
The Diplomatic Corps of Sordland has a well-earned reputation for excellence, having educated some of the finest diplomats who have excelled in their field over the past century.

Sordland is a key member of the founding members of OMEC as many of its economic experts have Sordish descent. The contribution of Sordland's economic experts has been crucial in the establishment and development of OMEC as a prominent economic organization.

Sordland's independence and prominent role on the international stage are not fully secured as it lacks strong allies. Without the support of reliable allies, Sordland may struggle to assert its interests and maintain its position in the global arena.

The expansionist doctrine of Rumburg over the last century has led to a highly volatile situation on the Merkopa continent. Rumburg's actions have contributed to increased tensions and instability in the region, with potential negative consequences for neighboring nations like Sordland.

The Agnland region is in crisis as the lack of investment has led to a rapid decline in its economy. The region, which was once known for its stable economy, is now facing unprecedented challenges that threaten its social fabric and economic stability. With rising levels of crime, homelessness, and unemployment, the region is struggling to cope.

The region's economy is declining at a rapid rate due to the lack of investment, resulting in an increase in crime, homelessness, and unemployment. We must take immediate action to address the underlying issues by increasing investment, promoting job growth, and creating new economic opportunities.

Previous government attempts to solidify trade relations were unsuccessful, which combined with the effects of the recession, resulted in a significant decrease in trade volume. Without effective measures to address the underlying issues driving the decrease, the country may face continued economic challenges.

Despite concerted efforts and strategic investments, the economic situation in Gruni is demonstrating marginal stability. The region, famed for its fertile vineyards and vital export sector, is grappling with notable economic challenges that impact its growth potential.

The economy of the region is experiencing a rapid decline due to a lack of investment. This has resulted in a rise in crime, homelessness, and unemployment. These challenges have a significant impact on the region's residents, with many struggling to make ends meet and access basic services.

The mismanagement and lack of direction of economic policies, along with the recession, has resulted in a stagnation in production of goods. As a consequence, the country's economy is struggling to recover, with high unemployment rates and decreasing business investments.

It has come to the attention of the government that serious tax evasion practices are being exercised by important businesses and other parts of the populace. This is a concerning issue that needs to be addressed in order to ensure a fair and stable tax system for all citizens.
Tourism Industry at Average Activity Level

Across Sordland, the tourism industry is demonstrating stable performance, operating at an average activity level. The consistent influx of tourists visiting our nation's various attractions aligns with the expected trends, reflecting the steady appeal of Sordland's diverse cultural and natural heritage.

The high unemployment rate has caused a significant impact on Sordish society, leading to an increase in poverty, crime, and homelessness. Families are struggling to make ends meet, and many people are unable to find work despite their qualifications and experience. This has also led to a brain drain, with many skilled workers leaving the country in search of better job opportunities.

Sordland's transportation network has been neglected for years, resulting in outdated and poorly maintained infrastructure. This not only affects the movement of goods and services but also slows down the daily commute for citizens. The lack of investment in this critical area has led to a decrease in efficiency, higher transportation costs, and longer commute times.

Sordland has a complex relationship with its Bludish population, with discrimination and unequal treatment being a persistent issue. The Bludish people continue to face systemic barriers to education, employment, and political representation. This has led to a growing sense of frustration and disenfranchisement among the Bludish.

The Sordish legal system is facing a significant backlog in courts, causing strain and delays in the administration of justice. The delays have resulted in disorder and frustration among the litigants, and the backlog is causing unintentional injustices as judges are unable to provide timely responses.
Sordland has a free press and individuals are generally able to express themselves through various forms of media without significant government interference.
A political and constitutional dispute has arisen between the Supreme Court and the Ministry of Justice over their respective legal authority, causing tensions within the government.

Women in Sordland face extreme sexism, both in the workplace and at home. In addition, the law prohibits girls from learning natural and social sciences, among other subjects. Women are often paid less than their male counterparts. Furthermore, they have little to no legal protection in cases of domestic abuse.

Despite efforts to uphold human rights, violations continue to occur in Sordland due to the broad powers granted to law enforcement. While some rights are protected, such as freedom of speech and assembly, others are routinely violated, such as the right to a fair trial and protection against police brutality.

The Sordish General Staff is comprised of highly skilled and experienced generals, who have served in the military for many years. Their extensive experience and knowledge allow them to make informed and strategic decisions, enabling the military to operate with precision and effectiveness.

The Ministry of Defense is responsible for maintaining security within Sordland, and this includes the use of the Gendarmerie, a special military force that operates within the country's borders. The Gendarmerie is tasked with maintaining law and order in areas where civil authorities are unable to do so, and they are authorized to use force if necessary to achieve their objectives.

The military has a significant reservist pool that can be called upon during times of war or crisis. These reservists often have prior military experience and can be rapidly mobilized to augment the active duty forces. In addition, the reservist system serves as a means of maintaining military readiness during peacetime by providing regular training and drills to reservists, ensuring that they are prepared to quickly integrate with the active duty forces if needed.

The military actively interferes in the political landscape, using their influence and power to further their will. In Sordland, the military has a history of political involvement and influence, with some past governments relying on the military's support.

The outdated equipment in the Sordish armed forces is posing a serious threat to the country's national security and combat readiness. The equipment, which has been in use for several decades, is no longer capable of meeting the demands of modern warfare, making it difficult for the armed forces to effectively respond to evolving threats. This has not only compromised the safety and security of Sordland but has also weakened its standing as a regional military power.
Despite efforts to counteract their activities, the immediate threat from the Bludish Freedom Front persists, maintaining a state of unrest and potential instability within Sordland.

The pervasive corruption in Sordland has created a culture of inefficiency and undermined the rule of law. Despite recent efforts to combat corruption, reports suggest that the problem persists at all levels of society, from government officials to private sector actors. This has led to a lack of trust in public institutions and hampered economic growth and development.
Dispute with the Governor of Bergia

The Ministry of Interior and the Governor of the Special Zone of Bergia are currently in a legal dispute regarding the jurisdiction and control of internal security matters within the region of Bergia. Due to the special laws of Bergia, the Bergian local security forces do not fall under the authority of the Ministry of Interior, causing issues with communication and collaboration with the central government.

Sordland is currently facing a significant challenge with increased immigration and a lack of clear policy on how to handle it. The government's indecision has left loopholes in the system that are being exploited by some. The situation is complicated by the fact that many of the immigrants are fleeing conflict and persecution in neighboring countries. This has resulted in a large number of undocumented individuals entering the country, creating a strain on resources and leading to increased crime rates in some areas.

The Koranelli and Skinner cartel, among other dangerous criminal organizations, continue to conduct organized crime activities while remaining elusive to law enforcement. Their illegal operations have caused significant harm to society and the rule of law, and efforts to stop their activities have been largely unsuccessful. Despite the best efforts of the police and anti-crime units, these criminal networks continue to operate with impunity, creating a sense of fear and insecurity among citizens.

To ensure the wellbeing of its citizens, Sordland has developed well-funded welfare institutions in its urban areas. These institutions are designed to provide support for those in need, including the elderly, disabled, and those experiencing financial difficulties. The government has made significant investments to ensure that these institutions are well-equipped and staffed with trained professionals who can provide the necessary assistance to those who require it.

The varying opinions of different governments have resulted in a lack of consistency in the education system in Sordland. This inconsistency can lead to confusion among students, and they may receive an incomplete education. It can also impact the quality of education that students receive, as different curriculums may have different standards. This can lead to an educational gap between students who attend schools with different curriculums.

In rural areas of Sordland, the lack of accessibility to education has become a major issue. The distance between small villages and towns and the nearest schools makes it difficult for many children to attend school regularly. This has led to a significant disparity in educational opportunities between rural and urban areas, which can have long-term effects on the social and economic development of the country.

The underdeveloped rural areas of Sordland have been facing major challenges in accessing quality healthcare services. The lack of basic hygiene and medical facilities has resulted in several illnesses and deaths, leading to a serious public health concern. The shortage of medical staff in these areas also adds to the challenges in providing prompt and efficient medical care to the residents.

The welfare system in Sordland is currently facing significant challenges due to a variety of factors such as the lack of adequate funding and political mismanagement. As a result, the system is overburdened and struggling to provide essential services to those who need them the most. Many vulnerable individuals and families are finding it increasingly difficult to access the support they need to survive, let alone thrive. This has led to an increase in poverty, homelessness, and other related social issues.

With schools and universities providing a solid understanding of our founding father, Tarquin Soll, students will be able to learn about the values, principles, and history that shaped our country. Through this education, they can develop a deep appreciation for their heritage and a sense of pride in their nation. Moreover, by understanding the struggles and sacrifices made by our founding father, students can develop a sense of responsibility towards their country and become informed and active citizens who work towards the betterment of their society.
